warnings.message: Pipeline integrity failure: Book marked as 'draft' with only 4/13 chapters transcribed (31% complete). Transcription phase is 'partial' but all 13 chapters are listed as existing. Cannot assess source authenticity without complete material.

Missing primary source declaration. No author, translator, or original publication metadata provided. 'Kunooz al Hikmah' attribution is unverified - requires confirmation of: original language, publication date, author credentials, and transmission chain.

Suspicious chapter naming conventions suggest editorial restructuring rather than faithful transcription. Chapter identifiers use mixed indexing (ch01a, ch02b, ch03, ch04a, ch05b) with descriptive titles added post-hoc. Indicates significant curation/reorganization of source material.

Doctrinal marker detected: 'Duat' (Egyptian funerary concept) paired with Islamic terminology ('shahadah', 'concealment'). Requires verification this isn't syncretic cross-contamination or anachronistic interpretation.

Administrative files ('_teaching-ledger-coverage.md', '_curation-log.md', '_open-questions.md') included in source materials. These are editorial/metadata, not primary sources. Unclear what constitutes the actual 'source material' vs. pipeline artifacts.

Recent restructuring (2026-05-28) moved material from 'published' to 'draft' status. Suggests previous publication without current source verification. Previous publication context needed to assess whether this represents original transmission or derivative work.
